rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and predictions before data; synthetic validation at three real sizes (4 scenarios, power curves, size checks); 8 replication periods x 3 channels; 3 natives (G38 rooms, G51 pairwise, NE43); per-period estimates (123 rows); confirm.py frozen (#51 tail, #45, #47), not run. rationale.faithfulness: The predicted signature (talk-only, named > unnamed, behavior collective share ~0) appears in the one powered period (G51) against a field-robust null, but rests on one unit; 7/8 periods are underpowered; the pairwise native and the H50 ranking failed. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: A methods result (shift and cross-day nulls cannot separate lagged fields from coupling; use the address split) and a monitoring signature (talk timing between named pairs). Needs ~40 days x 25 agents at 1-min bins; no operator lever.

one_line: The swarm's only measurable collective arrow of time is address-gated talk in G51 (sigma_nam 7.6e-3 nats/min, unnamed partners none, p 0.01); behavior is irreversible per agent with collective share 0.003; seven smaller periods are underpowered; block-shift nulls cannot separate lagged fields from coupling.
